scholarship_title: CICOPS Scholarships 2027 (Visiting Scholars from Developing Countries)
provider_organization: University of Pavia (CICOPS) with EDiSU Pavia
eligible_nationalities: All (based on residence: must live in a World Bank low, lower-middle or upper-middle income country at the deadline)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Not applicable (research visit, not a degree)

stipend.notes: EUR 150 gross per week for a 4-12 week stay in 2027 (11 Jan - 24 Jul or 6 Sep - 18 Dec). Paid after arrival in Pavia. 8 scholarships.

additional_benefits: Housing (single room in a university college)
Meals (two free meals a day at university canteens)
Visa support letter (visa cost contribution in special cases)

application_fee.notes: No fee mentioned in the call.

eligibility_criteria.work_experience_years: PhD plus current university job, and/or at least 2 years' employment (teaching, research or technical) at a university, public/non-profit research centre or international public body in an eligible country

country_specific_notes.note: Nigeria is a World Bank lower-middle income economy, so Nigerian residents can apply. Lower-income applicants get preference when scores are equal. No Nigerian was among the 8 winners for 2027 (150 applications).

required_documents.name: Invitation/acceptance letter from a University of Pavia professor or researcher
At least 2 authored publications in the proposed field

preparation_alerts: You must find and secure a University of Pavia host before applying; CICOPS will not suggest supervisors (use the UNIFIND search tool)
Apply only after you have the host letter; incomplete applications are rejected
Not open to people already enrolled in an Italian PhD or postgraduate course
Winners must accept within 20 days and give exact stay dates

criteria.notes: Especially when linked to University of Pavia projects

criteria.criterion: Fair spread across departments and regions

verification_status.verification_notes: Rechecked 2026-10-28 against the official signed CICOPS 2027 call (University of Pavia + EDiSU). Changes: number of awards confirmed as 8; weekly contribution EUR 150 gross found; insurance, meals, housing confirmed; eligibility is by residence, not nationality; work/PhD and publication rules added.
